name: Addis Ababa
summary: Addis Ababa, capital of Ethiopia and headquarters of the African Union, sits at more than 2,350 meters above sea level, which gives it a mild and stable climate all year round despite its tropical latitude. The cost of living is low and it has a nascent coworking scene (iceaddis, blueSpace, ShegerHive) linked to a growing startup ecosystem. The internet is far behind other nomadic hubs, and exchange restrictions and banking friction for international payments are a real obstacle to take into account.
